paper.title: Library Drift: Diagnosing and Fixing a Silent Failure Mode in Self-Evolving LLM Skill Libraries
paper.central_claim: “库漂移”（无结果驱动生命周期管理的无界技能累积导致检索退化、假阳性注入与停滞）是自进化技能库的静默失败模式；可由消融复现、由轨迹级诊断检出，并可由结果驱动退役+容量上限+元技能先验的最小治理方案修复（MBPP+ hard-100 留出 pass@1 0.258→0.584）。

provenance.notes: actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref null: worker subagent has no accessible run receipt; model type as dispatched by controller. RE-n in rs: expectation ids = n-th bullet of the card Reviewer expectations section.

sections_read: §6 实验（含 Table 1 与成本）

evidence.quote: unbounded skill accumulation without outcome-driven lifecycle management causes retrieval degradation, false-positive injections, and performance stagnation.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者中心主张：库漂移=无生命周期管理的无界技能累积导致检索退化与停滞。

evidence.quote: unbounded growth degrades retrieval until injections become harmful
evidence.support_explanation: “bloat”子模式的定义。

evidence.quote: prevented in our Default by the active-cap
evidence.support_explanation: “bloat”仅被声明由 cap 预防，文中没有去 cap/去退役的复现实验。

evidence.quote: The Router is forced to none : the full pipeline (synthesizer, critic, curator) still runs, but no skill is ever injected into the solver prompt.
evidence.support_explanation: A1：保持全流程但禁用注入的 store-off 对照，是文中最干净的控制。

evidence.quote: The bank collapses to 2 active skills, and the router’s 18.9% engagement means it rarely injects, yet when it does, the surviving skills hurt.
evidence.support_explanation: A4：过严退役使库塌陷并低于无技能基线——复现的是“侵蚀”，不是“累积”。

evidence.quote: The effect is consistent across all three seeds
evidence.support_explanation: A4 三个种子一致为负。

evidence.quote: conservative enough that useful skills survive stochastic noise
evidence.support_explanation: 退役规则：N_min=100、τ=0.10 的 Hoeffding 论证（范围与独立性假设见 E010）。

evidence.quote: forces the curator to evict the lowest-contribution skill when synthesis would exceed the cap
evidence.support_explanation: 容量上限 C=50 的淘汰规则。

evidence.quote: computed from the evidence log (capsules where s s was injected)
evidence.support_explanation: 贡献分仅由被注入该技能的任务的成败计算（Eq.2 为 (成功−失败)/试次），无无技能反事实。

evidence.quote: Tasks routed to a surviving skill have expected pass probability
evidence.support_explanation: 命题 1 证明把 ĉ≥−τ−ε 当作相对 p0 的差，而 ĉ 的定义是绝对 2p−1，且 Hoeffding 取 [0,1] 值域——our_inference。

evidence.quote: The bound is loose at our scale (the system gains +0.328 rather than losing 0.35) but rules out unbounded degradation.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者自述界松（−0.35）。

evidence.quote: we discard tasks that Claude Opus 4.7 solves on all 5 baseline seeds
evidence.support_explanation: 任务筛选：去掉该模型 5 次全对的题，再抽 100 题。

evidence.quote: randomly sample 100 from the remainder (60 train / 40 eval, fixed seed)
evidence.support_explanation: 60 训练/40 评测；评测集每轮重复使用。

evidence.quote: The Solver is a single direct LLM call with no execution feedback, no self-refinement, and no tool use, isolating the skill library’s contribution.
evidence.support_explanation: 单次调用、无工具，隔离技能库贡献。

evidence.quote: Each run is 100 rounds; we report mean
lifts pass@1 from 0.258 baseline to 0.584 late-window mean (peak 0.658)
cross-condition variation is sampling noise from
evidence.support_explanation: 基线跨条件波动来自 n=40 评测集采样噪声（0.200–0.325）。

evidence.quote: Ablation A3 (no meta-skill) shows that removing it costs 43% of the Default’s gain; it is the single most valuable component.
evidence.support_explanation: 元技能先验是最大单项贡献（去除损失 43%）。

evidence.quote: The meta-skill subsumes explicit dedup at this scale
evidence.support_explanation: A5/A6 去掉去重略高于默认，设计假设被反驳。

evidence.quote: the cap primarily controls variance rather than mean performance at this scale
evidence.support_explanation: A7 翻倍 cap 均值不变，仅方差更大——cap 的均值效应未被证明。

evidence.quote: confirming the LLM gate contributes beyond tf-idf
evidence.support_explanation: A2 说明 LLM 门控在检索之外有贡献（约 24% 增益）。

evidence.quote: none pairs outcome-driven retirement with a bounded active-cap, the two mechanisms our ablation analysis identifies as load-bearing for preventing drift.
evidence.support_explanation: “退役+cap 承重”的结论依据：文中没有 retire-off 或 cap-off 的消融。

evidence.quote: which mechanisms are load-bearing (retirement, meta-skill) and which are safely removed (explicit dedup)
evidence.support_explanation: 作者结论列出退役为承重机制。

evidence.quote: 43% more than the no-skill baseline
evidence.support_explanation: 默认设置的调用量比无技能基线多 43%。

evidence.quote: Wall time is 6.5 h vs. A1’s 2.3 h
One benchmark (MBPP+ hard-100); generalization to broader domains (multi-step agents, SWE-Bench) is left to future work.
evidence.support_explanation: 单基准。

evidence.quote: Single model (Claude Opus 4.7); cross-model stability not established.
evidence.support_explanation: 单模型。

evidence.quote: The diagnostic thresholds (when to intervene) are empirically chosen
evidence.support_explanation: 阈值经验选取，且 A1–A8 与默认值共用同一 40 题评测集。

evidence.quote: routes active skills on held-out tasks
evidence.support_explanation: 每轮先在评测集上路由；证据日志是否含评测胶囊未说明。

evidence.quote: Rollback persistence Consecutive rounds 5
evidence.support_explanation: 超参表含回滚参数，正文未描述回滚机制。

evidence.quote: The trace-level diagnostics detected drift before end-task metrics declined.
evidence.support_explanation: 诊断先于终端指标的声称（A4，库塌陷发生于第 30 轮）。

evidence.quote: LLM-authored skills deliver +0.0pp over no-skill baselines while human-curated ones deliver +16.2pp.
evidence.support_explanation: 动机症状来自外部 SkillsBench。

evidence.quote: refuting our design assumption that explicit dedup would help
evidence.support_explanation: 作者如实报告设计假设被反驳。

G.reason: 问题有外部来源（SkillsBench +0.0pp、综述称生命周期“largely neglected”），最近邻列得具体；但“无界累积导致漂移”的核心前提未被直接验证，且“无系统同时具备退役+cap”的检索范围未说明。

M.reason: “累积→检索稀释→静默注入伤害”的机制论证合理，A1/A4 括出两侧；但贡献分是绝对成败差而非相对无技能的反事实，难题技能会被误退，命题 1 把绝对贡献当相对差且 Hoeffding 值域取 [0,1]，关键假设薄弱。

X.reason: 五阶段循环、路由两段检索+LLM 门控、合成触发、退役/cap/元技能规则与超参完整，代码公开；但回滚参数只见超参表、正文未描述，证据日志是否含评测胶囊不明。

E.measurement.reason: MBPP+ pass@1 有可执行测试，单次调用无工具隔离技能效应，A1 同管线对照把回归均值风险基本排除；但 40 题评测与任务筛选使噪声大（基线 0.20–0.325），且 MBPP+ 预训练污染未查。

E.causality.reason: A1（skill-off）、A2、A3 提供可信的组件归因，但核心机制（退役、cap、无界累积致漂移）缺少关闭/无治理对照，A4 复现的是过度治理而非累积，也没有与现有无治理系统的外部基线。

E.holdout.reason: 有 60/40 训练/评测划分且技能由训练失败合成，但评测集同时服务于全部消融、阈值经验选取，证据日志是否含评测结果参与退役未说明，MBPP+ 污染未查，仅单基准单模型。

E.statistics.reason: 3 个种子、均值±标准差与逐种子表、对 A5/A6 采用 2σ 谨慎表述，并报告负结果；但 n=3、无显著性检验、40 题评测。

E.cost.reason: 给出调用数（+43%）、墙钟（6.5h 对 2.3h）、A8 10.1h，且把成本放入设计取舍；但与其他方法无预算对等比较。

rationale: 技能库治理：A1无注入对照显示完整方案0.26→0.58，但退役/cap无关闭消融，累积致漂移未复现，命题1推导有缺陷，单基准。
